description: Cutaway artist Matt Cushman shares with #AdamSavage his new massive cross-section poster of the original #StarTrek #USSEnterprise, sized as large as the original 11-foot filming model. It’s an extraordinary project, and you really should watch the whole video.
title: Does Star Trek's USS Enterprise Design Make Sense?

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Ridley Scott's Alien (1979) wasn't just groundbreaking for its depiction of the titular xenomorph creature, but also the characterization of its "space trucker" protagonists. Key to that were their well-worn Nostromo uniforms, which we get to examine at Propstore. Adam admires the various patches, piping trim, and zipper closures, including details he's never seen before. Plus, a few special effects props from Aliens!

Learn more about this prop and the upcoming Propstore EMLA auction: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/info/id/525
